title: Shadowing for weighted composition operators on spaces of continuous functions
summary: In this work, we characterize the shadowing property for weighted shifts on a general class of Banach sequence spaces, extending a theorem proved by Bernardes et al. in ETDS (2020). We then apply this result to characterize this property for weighted composition operators acting on a class of Banach spaces of continuous functions. As an application, we present a characterization of shadowing for bilateral weighted translations on the spaces $C_b(\mathbb{R})$ and $C_0(\mathbb{R})$.
